name: King Tower

meta.level_note: Tower level equals king level; tournament standard is level 11 for towers and cards.

units.coordinate_system: origin at arena center; own side is y < 0 (positions live in arena.json)

provenance_legend.app: measured or read by the user in the Clash Royale app

base.collision_shape: square footprint; radius is half the side length
base.first_hit_scope: applies to targets acquired after the king's first shot; the first shot after activation uses activation.first_shot

targeting.selection_detail: the tower targets the first enemy that enters its range
targeting.keeps_target_until: target dies or leaves range, then it retargets
targeting.when_target_lost: take the enemy that has been in range longest; ties go to the nearest, then the lowest entity id
targeting.confirmed_by_user: first target seen in range; keep until dead or out of range, then retarget; ties go to nearest, then lowest entity id

projectile.speed_derivation: 7000 millitiles of range / 20 ticks (1 second) = 350; flight time shrinks in proportion to distance
projectile.flight_ticks_formula: max(1, ceil(distance_millitiles / 350)), distance from tower center to target center
projectile.speed_confirmed_by_user: the 1 second flight is measured at maximum range and the speed is constant

first_shot.if_no_target_in_range_when_ready: wait and fire at the first target seen (simulator rule)
first_shot.counts_activation_to_firing: confirmed: the 4 seconds run from activation to firing, not to landing

tower_rules.on_destroyed: match ends immediately with 3 crowns to the other side
tower_rules.dual_cannon_note: The two-cannon king exists only in 2v2.

unverified: If a target dies in flight the projectile does nothing (simulator rule; not asked).
If no target is in range when the first shot is ready, the king fires at the first target seen (simulator rule; not asked).
Damage reduction from spells and Miner is stored on those cards' files.
